Sources/MetronomeCore/Rhythm.notes: Rhythm engine with subdivisions (triplets, 6-tuplets, shuffle) and pattern timing

Sources/MetronomeCore/Audio.notes: AVAudioEngine audio synthesizer, PCM clicks, reference drone, and robust macOS sleep/wake graph recovery

Sources/MetronomeCore/State.notes: Practice time tracker, monotonic wall-clock target timer (decoupled from beat ticks), daily stats, and presets

Sources/MetronomeCore/Trainers.notes: Speed trainer (tempo ramp) and Gap trainer (silent measure) algorithms

Sources/MetronomeCore/Engine.notes: Unified orchestrator bridging audio, rhythm scheduler, trainers, practice tracking, and system sleep/wake notifications

Sources/MetronomeApp.notes: SwiftUI macOS Desktop UI with clean minimalist layout, target timer toggle/auto-shutoff dismiss, and pendulum
